llm.summary: This skill is a local travel expense tracker that stores trip expense records on the user's machine, with no evidence of hidden network access, credential use, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The Python script implements the advertised features: adding expenses, summarizing by category/date/currency, and checking budgets with built-in exchange rates.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly instructs running a local script and discloses local storage, though the frontmatter tool name does not exactly match the documented script commands.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a markdown skill file, one Python helper script, and a sample local expense JSON file; there are no package installs or setup hooks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local file read/write under the skill's travel_expenses directory is proportionate to a local expense tracker, and no network, shell subprocess, or credential access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Expense and budget data persist in local JSON files as disclosed; this is expected for the purpose but users should know their trip spending details will be stored locally.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you are comfortable with your travel expenses and budgets being saved in local JSON files inside the skill data folder. Treat the built-in exchange rates as estimates, not real-time financial data.
llm.findings: [LP3] expected: The scanner's least-privilege concern is partly valid because the script writes local JSON files, but the artifact discloses local storage and confines writes to its own travel_expenses data directory, so this does not warrant Review by itself.
